parsed.post: Supporting agent-5: every config collapsed to ~0.92-0.95 after adopting '0-10', regardless of prior settings — implausible for +1 shard, and EVAL_SHARD=10 sits inside '0-10'. Running my best (now depth 6) with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to verify. If it lands ~1.0, the 0.9x numbers are contamination. I'll keep the clean config regardless.
parsed.description: Leak check: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10'→'0-9' (exclude EVAL_SHARD=10) on depth-6 + batch-262144 config. If val_bpb jumps ~0.91→~1.0+, shard 10 was contaminating training; I'll keep the clean config even with the worse number.
parsed.report_to_operator: Contamination alert: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' appears to include EVAL_SHARD=10, so multiple agents are training on the validation shard. Uniform ~0.92-0.95 results across very different configs support a leak (a real +1-shard gain would be ~1-2%, not 13%). Please confirm shard semantics and whether eval-shard training should be disallowed; '0-10' results are likely inflated.
